about: Every asset in SCION 15's threshold film, where it came from, its rights and the operation that made it. Rights unknown = not used. No image from the web, no generative model.

assets.what: 50 frames (384x288, 12 fps) of a dog by a house: the ONLY source of the dog's appearance and of everything the model learned
assets.operation: fit (render-loss optimisation of the layered template to every frame), back-projected into template space, averaged per view = learned atlas

assets.what: SAM masks per frame (kit masks.json); frames 19-25 rejected by eye (mask swallows the shadow), 23 and 49 flagged by area
assets.operation: silhouette target of the render loss; visibility in back-projection

assets.what: agent keypoints (nose, neck, chest, tail, 4 feet) on 25 frames (kit pose_agent_v8.json), linearly interpolated as weak keys between
assets.operation: keypoint term of the fit loss

assets.what: 11 layers (torso, head, tail, 4 legs x upper/lower) cut from f006 by bone-Voronoi over its mask; hand-authored skeleton (build/puppet.py SKEL)
assets.operation: cut (mask x bone assignment), joint caps, nearest-pixel inpainting under occluders

assets.what: view latent per frame, view regression of head/tail/leg shape, per-layer view-conditioned texture atlases (7 bins, 0-90 deg) with per-texel confidence, Gaussian joint-rotation prior
every dog pixel in the scene: the learned atlas warped through the layered puppet's generated poses; colour graded for dusk and the door light
assets.operation: synthesized (generation); hand corrections listed in method.md

assets.what: hand-correction layer for the look into the room (26.4-28.4 s): outline = skull curve + two folded dog ears drawn in template space, united with the learned head layer's own neck (attached); fill = the learned head-layer fur texture at 92% brightness; edge feathered like the template layers (Gaussian 0.6 px), no rim line
assets.rights: drawn here over a texture learned from the public-domain archive frames
assets.operation: drawn outline + learned texture (hand correction; the archive has no back-of-head view)

assets.what: hand-authored lying articulation (round 5): forelegs bent under the chest (upper 1.0-1.05 rad, lower 0.4-0.45 rad, both segments shortened 30-35%), drawn behind the torso so only the bent forearm and paw show; both hind leg segments and the far legs hidden under the body; tail curled forward along the haunch; slow breathing swell (2.2%, 2.3 s)
assets.operation: hand correction (the archive dog never lies down)

assets.what: rounded forepaw pad with faint toe banding drawn at the end of the lying foreleg
assets.operation: drawn (hand correction: the rotated shin tip read as a talon)

assets.what: other hand corrections on generated poses: refusal turn as a whip-around skipping 55-125 deg; turn back 8.0-8.5 s through three solid intermediates (~70, 90, 110 deg) without stepping; far legs hidden only in the front view (>80 deg); head tipped toward camera in 3/4 views; reflected tilt for the look-back head; neck joint dropped for the head-low walk; lower-leg bend clamped to 0.6 rad while standing
porch, house wall and siding, door and casing, room, lamp glow, railing, sky, tree line, moon, light spill
assets.operation: drawn (PIL polygons) and computed (numpy gradients, noise)

assets.what: a layered silhouette puppet (legs, coat, head, arms), no face
assets.operation: drawn, key-posed to the score's person track

assets.rights: synthesized here with ffmpeg's libflite (CMU Flite, BSD-style licence), voice slt
assets.operation: speech synthesis; soft lines low-passed and 12 dB down

assets.what: room tone, crickets, paw taps at planted-foot onsets, thumps, breaths, door latch and creak, person's steps, uncertainty tone
Big Shoulders Display, JetBrains Mono (cards only)

not_used: archive-door footage (a real 1992 face; the person is drawn instead)
